items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: a cat named Mike Walker, saxophone was his instrumentation -- saxophone, guitar and bass -- we worked up on this job about six months

ctx.x: And I'm happy to be able to do things like that. Sometimes you can make or break a band and have somebody in that band that knows some of those tunes that somebody might want. We had a little gig back in the '40s, when I come out of service, a cat named Mike Walker, saxophone was his instrumentation -- saxophone, guitar and bass -- we worked up on this job about six months. Every night, at least twice a week, this guy would come in and as soon as he walked in the door, he wanted to hear Milenbergy Milenburg Joys.…
Then it got to the point where some of the so-called hip cats won't play the requests, you know. They didn't want to admit they didn't know them.
